description: Temporary Test UI. Reset quests by giver zone, preserve onboarding and other zones, back up verified save before mutation, retain claimed one-time reward locks in qprog arrays.

Сброс отменён.'};const backupKey=KEY+'-before-zone-reset';try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(KEY);if(!raw)throw Error('empty');localStorage.setItem(backupKey,raw);if(localStorage.getItem(backupKey)!==raw)throw Error('backup');}catch(e){return {ok:false,message:'Не удалось создать резервную копию. Сброс отменён.'};}const previous={q:h.q,qprog:h.qprog,rep:h.rep,dly:h.dly};h.q=Object.assign({},h.q);h.qprog=Object.assign({},h.qprog);h.rep=Object.assign({},h.rep);h.dly=Object.assign({},h.dly);for(const q of quests){if(!q.daily&&!q.rep&&(h.q[q.k]===3||azTestPaid(q.k)))h.qprog['az_test_paid:'+q.k]=[1];delete h.q[q.k];delete h.qprog[q.k];delete h.rep[q.k];delete h.dly[q.k];}if(save()!==true){Object.assign(h,previous);return {ok:false,message:'Не удалось сохранить сброс.
